description: What Swell Cabin posts on social media, worked out from its own data: swell alerts (a swell building to 1.5 m or more with a Good-or-better day in it, on days the three wave models agree on), the best day this week (Good or better, and big enough for the word: Good from waist high, Great from chest high, Epic from head high), the weekend's best-rated towns, a town's surf season opening, surf events, the evergreen kinds (where to surf this month: the best-known towns in season with the water and wetsuit; a town spotlight from its own record; about Swell Cabin, in its own numbers), and the weekly stories (swell on the move: a long-period swell reaching towns of one region in the order it arrives; the week ahead in numbers on Mondays; the local surf scene, a town's reviewed local accounts, on Tuesdays; learn to surf this weekend on Thursdays; surf by day, out by night on Fridays; the spot of the week with a reviewed, credited surf clip on Saturdays). Cards show the town's or spot's reviewed, freely licensed photo with its credit; a list's towns follow as photo slides; a post for a spot with a reviewed clip shares the clip as its video. With a town: the posts it would make about that town now, best first, each written for Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X, Bluesky and Mastodon with its time (UTC, in the town's morning or evening), link, card image (a PNG drawn from the same facts: card for a feed post, story for 9:16) and the facts every number comes from. Without a town: the latest daily proposal across every town (the owner approves it; the approved posts go out through Buffer) and the posts already scheduled. A post names a surf spot only when it is well known (it has a cam or surf clips), and never says today or tomorrow (it goes out later than it's written).

town.description: Town slug. Leave out for the latest daily proposal across every town and what is scheduled.
